You build and maintain data pipelines for our clients - different industries, different stacks, one engineering standard. Python and SQL will be your daily tools; a mentor and code review will be your safety net. We hire data engineers, not software developers who occasionally work w

enrichment.summary: Junior data engineer builds and maintains ETL/ELT data pipelines for clients across different industries, on-site in Cairo. Daily work centers on Python and SQL, with PySpark, Pandas/Polars, and Airflow/Dagster concepts; mentors help you grow into dbt, Docker, CI/CD, Snowflake, and Terraform.

requirements.text: 1+ year building software in Python
Python engineering: clean modular code, OOP basics, project setup from scratch, pytest tests
Git daily fluency: branches, commits, pull requests, review comments
SQL: joins, aggregations, window functions; any relational database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server)
DE concepts: ETL vs ELT, warehouse vs database vs lake, pipeline idempotency
Conceptual knowledge of Spark and Airflow (distributed processing, DAGs)
Basic hands-on experience with Spark or Airflow
Bash basics: navigate, grep logs, ssh
Conceptual understanding of one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
English B2 or higher
Streaming basics: Kafka, Kinesis
NoSQL exposure: MongoDB or DynamoDB
Data formats: Parquet, Avro
Docker basics

data.title: Senior Data Engineer
data.description:
GS1 Egypt continuously develops its data capabilities to support its products, services and business decisions. We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to work with our data and engineering teams to deliver reliable data pipelines, improve data quality and support analytics and data science.

This

requirements.text: 7+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing or data platforms, including hands-on technical leadership.
Demonstrated ownership of complex data platform implementations, from agreed architecture through production delivery and ongoing operation.
Strong SQL and Python skills, with practical experience in data modelling and ETL/ELT engineering.

Strong hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake or equivalent AWS/GCP services, including integration, orchestration, storage
Strong understanding of relational databases, incremental extraction, change data capture, schema evolution and historical data management.
Strong experience with data reconciliation, including source-to-target validation, entity resolution, conflict handling and auditable exception management.
Practical experience implementing data governance, including metadata management, cataloging, lineage, controlled access and auditable data handling.
Experience enabling self-service BI through platforms such as Metabase, Apache Superset or Power BI, including data connectivity, analytical models, access controls and query performance.
Experience with pipeline orchestration and dependency management using cloud-native services, Apache Airflow, Dagster or equivalent tools.
Strong knowledge of dimensional modelling, shared canonical models and slowly changing dimensions.
Experience with Git, automated testing and CI/CD for data workloads.
Ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, make defensible implementation decisions and deliver reliable solutions with limited supervision.
Exposure to data mesh, data fabric, event-driven architecture, and Lambda or Kappa patterns.
Experience with catalog and metadata tools such as OpenMetadata, DataHub, Apache Atlas or Microsoft Purview.
Experience with regulated product data, sector-specific schemas or GS1 standards.
Experience with distributed processing tools such as Apache Spark and open table formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Hudi.

data.title: Sr. Data Engineer - Spark
data.description: Building high-scale batch and near-real-time data pipelines deployed on infrastructure we run ourselves (on-prem), not managed cloud services. You will design and operate high-volume analytical data systems end to end, with Apache Spark as the core processing engine for both batch and streaming work

enrichment.summary: Senior data engineer designing and operating high-volume batch and near-real-time analytical pipelines on self-managed on-prem infrastructure, with Apache Spark (batch + Structured Streaming) as the core engine, alongside Kafka, Trino/Presto, OLAP stores, Airflow, and lakehouse table formats. Onsite in Cairo.

requirements.text: 7+ years of experience in data engineering and software development
Ability to write high-quality code in Java/Scala, Python, or equivalent languages
Deep hands-on production experience with Apache Spark (batch and Spark Structured Streaming)
Spark performance tuning: partitioning, caching/persistence, broadcast joins, shuffle reduction, data-skew handling, Adaptive Query Execution
Operating Spark on self-managed clusters (YARN, Kubernetes, or standalone) — executor sizing, resource allocation, multi-tenant workloads
Practical experience with Kafka (or equivalent) as a Spark source/sink, including offset and checkpoint management
Practical experience with distributed query engines (e.g., Trino/Presto)
Practical experience with ETL/data integration tools (e.g., Datastage, Informatica, Apache NiFi)
Practical experience with SQL-based transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt)
Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling and data warehousing for analytical workloads
Hands-on experience with real-time/low-latency analytical stores (e.g., Apache Pinot/ClickHouse)
Practical experience with big-data platforms and distributions (e.g., Cloudera, Hadoop ecosystem, Databricks)
Practical experience containerizing and operating data workloads with Docker
Kubernetes
Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)
Familiarity with data lake table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), including schema evolution and compaction
Familiarity with data governance/cataloging tools (e.g., DataHub)
Familiarity with lakehouse management systems (e.g., Apache Amoro)
Familiarity using AI tools for development and debugging (Claude, Cursor, Codex)
